name: Nandini Khandelwal
heroTitle: Interiors shaped around the way people live.
heroText: I create thoughtful, functional spaces through spatial planning, material sensitivity and a hands-on understanding of execution.
aboutTitle: From urban scale to intimate detail.
aboutText: With a Bachelor’s degree in Urban Planning and a Post Graduate Diploma in Interior Design, I approach every interior with a macro-to-micro perspective. My process combines circulation, functionality, material selection and visual storytelling—supported by practical site exposure and technical design skills.
availability: Open to interior design opportunities, collaborations and residential commissions.
